learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the organization and operation of production and commercial enterprises.
Developing the necessary competencies for establishing commercial companies in Romania.
Developing basic competencies regarding the management of production and commercial enterprises.
Developing the necessary competencies for analyzing the decision-making process and elaborating solutions for optimizing decisions.
Developing competencies regarding making decisions for organizing and managing human resources within an enterprise.

syllabus_topics: Management and managers: Definition, Evolution of management as a science
Elements of company theory: Typology of commercial companies in Romania. Stages of establishing commercial companies in Romania
Company sizing: Critical size of a company. Optimal size of a company. Business plan
Planning function of management: Strategic planning. SWOT analysis. Operational planning. Scheduling. Critical path analysis
Organization function of management: Organizational structures. Types of organizational charts. Elements of designing an organizational structure
Leading and leadership: Human resource leadership process and qualities of managers and leaders. Modern leadership methods
Control function of management: Elements of control in management. Types of control
Decision-making process in management: Definition, stages, typology of decisions. Decision utilities. Group decisions. Decisions under conditions of risk and uncertainty
Critical path analysis. Optimizing critical path analysis
teaching_methods: Lecture supported by PPT presentations, examples, case studies
Topic exposition, discussions, questions, solving specific problems, case studies

assessment_methods.method: Problem-solving corresponding to seminar hours, presentation of solutions, answers to questions
